The second equation describes the perpendicular bisector of the points \(4+k\) and \(k+3i\), which simplifies to the line
\[
8x-6y-8k-7=0.
\]
The first equation is the circle centered at \((25,20)\) with radius \(5\):
\[
(x-25)^2+(y-20)^2=25.
\]
For exactly one complex solution, the line must be tangent to the circle, so the distance from \((25,20)\) to the line equals \(5\):
\[
\frac{|8(25)-6(20)-8k-7|}{\sqrt{8^2+(-6)^2}}=5.
\]
\[
\frac{|73-8k|}{10}=5 \implies |73-8k|=50.
\]
Thus
\[
73-8k=50 \implies k=\frac{23}{8},
\]
or
\[
73-8k=-50 \implies k=\frac{123}{8}.
\]
The sum of all possible values of \(k\) is
\[
\frac{23}{8}+\frac{123}{8}=\frac{146}{8}=\frac{73}{4}.
\]
So \(m=73,\ n=4\), and \(m+n=77\).

ANSWER: 77
